slides.title: The problem — information is fragmented
items: Available land and assets are hard to discover across the corridor
Members see only part of the ecosystem — opportunities stay invisible
Incoming requests are hard to match efficiently to the right peers
Investors, companies, municipalities and partners navigate in silos
slides.closing: First reaction we want: “Yes, this is a real problem.”

slides.title: Why this idea — visibility before matching
items: Why visibility matters — gewerbe land, industry, power, transport in one picture
Why members struggle — no shared inventory of who holds what
Why opportunities fragment — partial lists, PDFs, personal networks
Then — a neutral map hosted by BER+ can respond without replacing planning roles

slides.title: What BER+ must do — pilot phase
items: Collect — member profiles, priorities, asset claims
Validate — locations and links with members (Arcadis, WFG, etc.)
Define — ownership of data refresh and matching rules
Maintain — quarterly OSM refresh, review queue
Host — neutral Board Room for board and member sessions
slides.closing: The platform is not magic — BER+ makes it real.

slides.title: Future phase — how the platform evolves
items: Verified member asset registry linked to the map
Matching at scale — more Mitglieder, more rules, more exports
Embedded in BER+ briefings, investor days, municipality sessions
Intelligence packs and advocacy evidence from live map exports
slides.closing: Goal: “We could start building this tomorrow.”
